Ruth (docs): Quick heads-up  I opened a small PR to clean up Optimize toolkit examples: fix broken batching link, standardize quant profile names, and update Python/TS snippets. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1555
Ibrahim (eng-ml): Thanks. Which quant names are mismatched?
Ruth (docs): Docs sometimes list 'q4f' while runtime and the model registry use 'q4_0'. Plan: canonicalize docs on 'q4_0' and add a tiny YAML alias mapping + migration note.
Ned (devex): Also the Node snippets use legacy streaming patterns. I'll replace with the async iterator example and add a short note on when to stream.
Ibrahim (eng-ml): Please avoid saying quant improves accuracy. Clarify it's memory/latency tradeoffs.
Ned (devex): TS stream snippet I'll add: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: 'redwood-2b', input: 'Short summary' })) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }
```
Ruth (docs): Can someone drop a minimal Python example for adaptive batching + prefix cache? Keep it 3-4 lines so it fits the quickstart box.
Ibrahim (eng-ml): Pasting one: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Summarize briefly', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=80, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(resp.text)
```
Ruth (docs): Perfect. I'll add a one-line table for batch_policy options (none | fixed-N | adaptive) and the migration FAQ: "If your runtime prints 'q4f', use 'q4_0' in toolkit docs."
QA-bot: PR 1555 opened by @ruth/docs: "optimize: snippet updates + quant alias mapping"  docs-lint passed :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (eng-ml): Quick review done; requested tiny wording tweak on quant note.
Ruth (docs): Addressed and merged. Changelog: "Optimize: canonicalize quant profile name (q4_0), refresh batching/caching snippets, add migration FAQ."
QA-bot: PR 1555 merged  docs deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:
Ned (devex): Thanks  I'll follow up with a short tweet-size note for the SDK changelog.
